finding: The design space lies entirely inside the objective's noise floor: no member is resolvably better or worse than the reference on the stability side. The panel is therefore a diversity panel over ties, not a selection of better candidates.
no_claim: The panel is NOT ranked. Members are ties unless explicitly classified resolvable.
The translation score distinguishes no member from any other; it has no measured resolution in this project.
No molecule in this project has been assayed.
A diversity panel is the defensible choice given an objective that cannot rank; it is not evidence that diversity is the right criterion for a real campaign.
purpose: Reframe the design pipeline from a ranked selector into a coarse filter plus a diversity selector, because the objective was measured to order at chance in the regime the design space occupies.
selection_method: coarse filter then deterministic farthest-point diversity

translation_side.note: These counts are reported to show the trap, not to license it: the stability floor was measured for a different model on a different quantity and does not transfer to RiboNN.
translation_side.why_not: The filter CANNOT be applied to the translation side. Every translation difference must be treated as unresolved, regardless of its size, until the translation side is externally validated.

what_the_output_may_claim: That the panel spans the design space, measured as the minimum pairwise Hamming distance achieved.
That each member's predicted values are recorded.
Where a member is resolvably worse or better than the reference on the STABILITY side, that it is so, with the fold difference and the concordance that licenses the claim.
what_the_output_may_not_claim: That the panel is ranked, or that any unresolved member is better than another.
That the translation score distinguishes any member from any other.
That a panel member will outperform the reference in an assay.
That the absence of resolvable members means the design space is bad; it means the objective cannot see it.
what_this_cannot_establish: Anything measured. No molecule in this project has been assayed.
That diversity is the right selection criterion for a real campaign; it is the defensible one given an objective that cannot rank.
That the resolution floor transfers to this project's construct, which at 1811 nt and 64.4 percent GC lies outside the dataset the floor was measured on.
